metadata.name: Accountant Website Template for Cursor: Free HTML Tax and Payroll Site with Tax Calendar and CSS Scroll Animations
metadata.description: Free accountant website template for a small practice that does bookkeeping, tax returns and payroll: sample monthly report, twelve-month tax calendar, switching steps, client stories, team, three fixed monthly plans and a form to book a free call. One HTML file, CSS scroll-driven animations, no libraries, no build step, MIT; GSAP build included. AGENTS.md and README prompt included. Page: 8b.com/templates/tallyhouse. Source: github.com/8bsite/accountant-website-template.
metadata.author: 8b
